oled.name: generic_woled
oled.description: Placeholder WOLED. Emission is per pixel (no zone grid). The WRGB mosaic is energy-preserving when box-filtered, so it does not change a flat color. ABL pulls the allowed peak down toward the full-field figure as APL rises. Spectral white-subpixel mixing beyond that mosaic is not modeled.

preview.exposure: shared sRGB mapping; no per-arm normalization

sampling: exact rational bin PTS/durations; emitted values are bin means; tracking uses midpoint spatial quadrature of those means
